notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating a Food token, a Clue token, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue token and the Food token to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
